card.name: Sentence-opening words in casual web prose
card.fires_on: Short linking or opening words such as 'With', 'till', 'lets' and 'back' that begin a clause or time phrase in informal general web text, often village or blog narrative.

modes.label: Time or condition openers
modes.description: Words like 'back', 'till' or 'With' start a time or condition phrase.

modes.description: Casual 'lets' or 'came' in chatty blog sentences.
modes.example: Then<< lets>> talk some tech now.
